about_the_game:
Sketch Top: An exclusive tool for players who like to operate two windows simultaneously, focusing on enabling users to switch between the two windows easily without changing their habits.Essential tools for painting beginners, allowing you to learn painting without barriers.

An Ideal Helper for Office Work

  • Customizable transparency allows users to transcribe content beneath the window with ease.

A Perfect Assistant for Painting

  • Customizable transparency supports users in practicing painting by referencing underlying content.

A Handy Tool for Gaming

  • Adjustable window size enables precise spatial utilization, optimizing gaming experiences.

【Practice Sketching on Your Computer】

Longing to practice drawing but short on time? Want to learn painting but fear it’s too difficult? Now, simply open an image to start practicing effortlessly. The software features a "Sketch Image" button that simplifies the process, helping you practice artistic perception. It removes barriers to painting—just like learning to write as a child, you can master painting if you want to.

【Watch Videos While Gaming】

If you’re used to multitasking by gaming and watching videos, try this tool—it’s more practical than "picture-in-picture" mode. Even in full-screen gaming, it won’t interfere with gameplay or display.

Feature Introduction

Normal Mode

  • Basic pinning effect: pin, mouse pass-through, minimize, adjust transparency, use shortcuts, and switch seamlessly.

Focus Mode

  • Select content to pin and display in a focused view. Features include: pinning, mouse pass-through, minimizing, transparency adjustment, shortcut support, and seamless switching.

Design Highlights

  • "Sketch Image" Button: A signature feature enabling users to learn painting as described above, making art accessible. Practicing painting also enhances mouse control, which benefits shooting game players.

  • Focus Mode: Streamlines the desktop and maximizes spatial efficiency.

  • Minimize Function: Tailored to user needs, it turns the software into a "convenience tool"—minimize with a single shortcut.

  • Seamless Switching: Maintains user habits while providing instant access to a pinned window.
